## Overview

Quantum error correction (QEC) provides the theoretical and practical framework for protecting quantum information against noise, decoherence, and imperfect control.
Because qubits cannot be cloned and measurements disturb quantum states, QEC differs fundamentally from classical error correction: information is encoded nonlocally across many physical qubits, and errors are inferred indirectly through _syndrome_ measurements.

QEC is the key bridge between noisy near-term devices and fault-tolerant quantum computing.
It combines stabilizer theory, coding theory, quantum circuit design, and hardware constraints into a unified stack for reliable computation.

This page is an onboarding entry point to QEC: it provides references for core concepts of the field and for practical software tools.

## Core Concepts to Master

1. Discretization of errors
2. Noise (error) channels (bit-flip, phase-flip, depolarizing, amplitude damping, etc.)
3. Bit-flip/phase-flip intuition and the role of redundancy in quantum encoding
4. Stabilizer formalism, syndrome extraction, and recovery operations
5. Parity-check matrix
6. Distance, logical qubits, and code rate tradeoffs
7. Threshold theorem (and fault-tolerance)
8. Decoding strategies (MWPM, belief propagation, neural decoders, etc.)
* Surface codes and topological protection principles

## References

### Textbooks and introductory guides

- Nielsen, M. A., & Chuang, I. L. *Quantum Computation and Quantum Information* (10th Anniversary Ed., Cambridge University Press, 2010). (QEC foundations)
    - [Chapter 10 - Quantum error-correction](https://profmcruz.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/quantum-computation-and-quantum-information-nielsen-chuang.pdf)
- Lidar, D. A., & Brun, T. A. (Eds.). *Quantum Error Correction* (Cambridge University Press, 2013).
    - [Chapter 2 - Introduction to quantum error correction](https://www.weizmann.ac.il/math/vidick/sites/math.vidick/files/uploads/Bacon_IntroToQEC.pdf)
- [Quantum Error Correction: An Introductory Guide](https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.11157)
- [An Introduction to Quantum Error Correction and Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/0904.2557)
- [Threshold theorem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Threshold_theorem)
